title: Crumbs
shortDescription: The Cookie Chain positions your wallet cannot show you, and the fees they left behind.
description: Crumbs is a portfolio view for Cookie Chain. Wallets list SPL balances and stop there, so a DAMM v2 liquidity position is invisible to them: it has no owner field at all, and ownership is a bearer NFT. Fees keep accruing to positions people have already withdrawn from. Crumbs reads every token account across SPL and Token-2022, aggregates per mint in bigint, derives each DAMM v2 position from the position NFTs a wallet already holds, and surfaces the unclaimed fees on each one with a claim action that simulates before it asks for a signature. It also decodes MomoSwap launchpad curve positions, which are program-tracked shares rather than SPL tokens, resolves .cook names in both directions, and ranks holdings by value. Everything is a public read, so any address or .cook name can be inspected without connecting a wallet.
